comparison.objective: Build a level pallet layer by pairing equal-height cartons; candidate tunes dynamic energy absorption.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-485 tests carton classification, standing, bridging, and bimanual stacking; candidate tests tool-mediated rotary adjustment and force-limited locking.
comparison.success_condition: PR-485 rejects tilted top cartons and cites an approximately 11° failure; candidate checks stroke, impacts, rebound, overload, and retention. No spec versions exist.
comparison.reason: Stable stacking and height pairing are not damper commissioning.
